title: A Brain-inspired Hierarchical Framework for Zero-Shot Robot Task Reasoning and Execution
authors: G. Wang, P. Ye, Q. Ying, **Y. Jing†**, Y. Ma, H. Chen, H. Wu, O. Wysocki, M. Duan, B. Sheil
tldr: Connects language instructions to zero-shot robot execution through explicit object-state reasoning, reusable atomic actions, and closed-loop verification.

media.alt: Brain-inspired hierarchical robot control: language-guided tasks, visual state inference, action generation and plan selection, with real-robot block stacking and whiteboard erasing.
